name: Sadie Nardini
reason: Health restore re-check, 13 Nov 2026 (sadienardini.com home and about pages; robots.txt allows us): the old health reason is moot, but the scope rule still excludes her. Her own site now presents her as founder of Face HIIT, a 'Natural Facelift' facial-exercise method sold with skincare (an Oliveda store, Face HIIT consultations and consultant training), and of Yoga HIIT, a high-intensity fitness format with its own certification; the about page frames all her methods as strength, anatomy and anti-ageing work. Her yoga (Core Strength Vinyasa) is presented as a physical/fitness style, and her yoga courses and trainings sit on agefiercely.com alongside the Face HIIT programmes. No meditation, retreat or other contemplative work of her own is offered. Skipped as mainly cosmetic and fitness work (gym-fitness scope).
